what: A tracker: patterns up to 16 tracks wide play DX7 FM, Juno-106, TB-303 and chip synths, samples and FUSION (a chord, layer or kit on each key), up to 16 voices. A loop station, two DJ decks, effects with punch-ins, automations, velocity keys, MIDI and clock in and out, USB audio.
author: hitosu
sounds: licensed: patches and samples from free sources, each named with its licence in demo-disk/CREDITS.md: CC0 1.0, BSD-2-Clause, CC BY-SA 4.0, GPL-3.0, MIT; the other patches and the songs own
